items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The musicians other than McClung, Goodwin, Horton, Burnett and myself were Arnold 'Scrip' Boling...

ctx.x: I remember that the film that was showing at the Palace during the week was 'What price Hollywood' starring Constance Bennett.
The musicians other than McClung, Goodwin, Horton, Burnett and myself were Arnold 'Scrip' Boling, ex- Cecil Scott,
drummer, Eugene Anderson, piano, Booker T. Pittman, Leroy Hardy, alto sax, Alfred Pratt, tenor sax.
